title: Free fall

slow_motion.evidence: no narration, captions, or on-screen text indicating slow motion; motion appears real-time

subjects.description: small shiny purple spherical ball falling vertically

observation.what_happens: A purple ball falls vertically from mid-air down to a brown floor. The free fall is already underway at the start of the clip and ends when the ball contacts the floor.

calibration.note: scale from the fall itself: 4157 px/s² over 4 arcs = g of 9.807 m/s²

given: g = 9.807 m/s² (Earth); it set the scale, so treat g as known and fixed
reasoning: y falls ~0.85 m in ~0.42 s then rebounds to successively lower peaks with near-constant height ratio ~0.36, while x grows steadily, indicating gravity flight plus a floor bounce with restitution ~0.6. The candidates test vacuum vs air drag to see if drag is needed to predict the later small bounces and steady horizontal motion.

caveats: Bounce is seen only in the final frames after impact, so restitution is less certain than the fall.
Floor height is inferred from the video, not measured directly.
Tiny sideways wobble looks like tracking noise, not physics.
critique.finding: The ball drops straight down pulled by gravity {g} and hits the floor at {yfloor}. It bounces back keeping part of its speed set by {e}, with almost no air slowing it.
critique.headline: Purple ball falls freely then bounces off floor
critique.why_it_won: It keeps the bounce off the floor but leaves out air drag that does nothing to help predict the fall.

headline: Purple ball falls freely then bounces off floor
finding: The ball drops straight down pulled by gravity 9.81 m/s² and hits the floor at -0.85 ± 4.25e-4 m. It bounces back keeping part of its speed set by 0.6 ± 1.65e-4, with almost no air slowing it.

eyeball.confidence: low - only thumbnail frame available, scale assumed from paper
eyeball.law_in_words: The ball center falls under constant gravity and when its height reaches yfloor the vertical velocity reverses and is multiplied by e, horizontal velocity unchanged.
